description: Read a task created by the current API key, including ready output.assets[].url links. Use those URLs directly without your API key; query again if assets are pending or URLs have expired. A verified complete v2 webhook already contains the result. Unknown and inaccessible IDs are both 404. Some models answer in words instead of a file: speech-to-text and other text results arrive in output.text with no assets, and a transcription may add output.transcript with word timings, timed segments (output.transcript.segments, with speaker labels when available) and the detected language. Embedding models return vectors in output.embeddings (inputTokens and data[].index/embedding); large results are summarized here, see output.embeddings.summary. Layer decomposition returns one image asset per layer; stack them by ascending output.assets[].layer.zIndex. Other asset roles: image-to-3d and text-to-3d return one `mesh` asset (a binary glTF .glb, mime model/gltf-binary); vector endpoints return `image` assets with mime image/svg+xml; video translation can add a `subtitle` asset (.srt); video extension that joins the source clip returns the joined `video` first and the new part as `segment`.
name: spicyapi_task_get

contentState.description: Whether the stored content is still there, and if not, who removed it: `expired` means the retention rules ran, `purged` means the account destroyed it on purpose.
